review.notes: Full re-review after the c9bed25 repairs: all ten previous findings repaired (R01 resolved on the supplier side, FFG R07.6.8 now states HasFiniteFlatModel.of_isUnramified). Gate OK on every rule; depcheck 208 roadmaps, 1477 edges, 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE; lake env lean exit 0 with four sorry warnings; #check of all six declarations, nothing lost to section variables; one-tactic probe fails on all four theorems (no padding). Sampled 1.1, 2.7, 2.9, 2.11, 2.12, 3.3, 3.10, 3.14a, 4.2, 4.4, 4.7, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5, 5.9 against Ribet 1994, Edixhoven, CG18, CG20, Buzzard 2000, Gross 1990 at the cited locators: all match. Adversarial table with computed values, including a numeric instance of weight_two_at_level_mul_prime (5.4.a.a vs 15a mod 3).
